name: my-polisher-extension
description: Text Polisher — on demand, rewrites user-generated English text into natural, native-sounding language.

scripts.test:e2e: cross-env VITE_ENABLE_TEST_BRIDGES=true wxt build -b chrome && node e2e/run-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:reddit: cross-env VITE_ENABLE_TEST_BRIDGES=true wxt build -b chrome && node e2e/reddit-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:firefox: cross-env VITE_ENABLE_TEST_BRIDGES=true wxt build -b firefox && wxt zip -b firefox && node e2e/firefox-e2e.mjs
